履修条件
Students who want to register for a course in ‘Doctoral Studies in Healthy Built Environment’ are required to use a programming language such as Fortran and Java.
授業概要
居住環境の快適・健康性，周辺環境との親和性，地球環境の保全など，建築の機能・役割について熱・空気・光・音の観点から考察し，建築環境・設備の重要性および社会的な意義を理解する。現在の課題や今後の進展について検討することにより研究目的と内容を創案し，博士論文作成に向けた研究指導を通じて，高度な工学の素養と論理的な思考および解析・表現方法を身に付ける。次世代高機能建築の設計，高効率設備システムの総合解析，建築の温湿度解析，省エネルギーおよび室内空気質に関する研究を指導する。
The formation of urban and architectural hygrothermal environment is analyzed by making clear natural and artificial heat and moisture transfer and airflow. On the basis of building physics, dwelling environment which is superior in terms of thermal comfort, energy conservation, health and durability, and high functionality buildings which are utilizing advanced equipment and renewable energy are put forward a proposal.

全体の教育目標
By understanding the fundamental theories on the combined phenomena on heat and moisture transfer and airflow in whole buildings, and its numerical analytical approach, the abilities to make architectural and equipment planning which take precedence to comfortable hygrothermal environment are developed. Then the capabilities to predict dwelling environment which is superior in terms of thermal comfort, energy conservation, health and durability, and to evaluate high functionality buildings which are utilizing advanced equipment and renewable energy are cultivated.
個別の教育目標
授業計画
1. Agenda for research
2. Understanding the fundamental theories on building physics
3. Understanding the mathematical model on building physics
4. Developing calculation program
5. Evaluate dwelling hygrothermal environment
6. Propose high performance buildings which are superior in terms of thermal comfort, energy conservation, health and durability and utilizing advanced equipment and renewable energy
